manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: A ball is tossed straight up on a fixed height scale. A motion arrow shrinks, vanishes at the top and points down, while the gravity arrow never changes.
assumptions: Gravity fixed at 9.8 m/s^2, no air resistance, up is positive.
manifest.description: A ball rises from a launch mark and falls back. The blue motion arrow shows velocity; the dashed gravity arrow stays the same. A callout names the motion state.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.

program.source: export function evaluate({inputs,time}){const u=inputs.launchSpeed,g=9.8;const T=2*u/g;const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(time,T));const apexTime=u/g;const apexHeight=u*u/(2*g);const v=u-g*t;const h=u*t-g*t*t/2;const top=Math.abs(t-apexTime)<0.005;const st=top?'Still for an instant':(v>0?'Moving up':'Moving down');const y0=370,sc=60;const by=y0-h*sc-14;const o=[];o.push(sdk.line('guide',200,y0,440,y0,{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.text('guide.l',210,y0+18,'Launch height 0 m',{role:'neutral'}));o.push(sdk.line('apex.g',200,y0-apexHeight*sc,440,y0-apexHeight*sc,{role:'neutral',opacity:0.3}));o.push(sdk.circle('ball.toss',320,by,28,{role:'output'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.v',{x:290,y:by},{value:top?0:v,direction:'up'},{scale:22,label:'v',role:'input'}));o.push(...sdk.vector('vec.a',{x:350,y:by},{value:-g,direction:'down'},{scale:0,minLength:40,label:'a',role:'warning'}));o.push(...sdk.callout(460,by-30,[st,'Gravity pulls down'],{id:'callout.toss'}));return {frame:{width:640,height:420,objects:o,readouts:[{id:'motionState',value:st},{id:'gravityState',value:'Gravity pulls down'}]},quantities:{launchSpeed:u,gravity:g,apexTime,apexHeight,velocity:v,height:h}};}
